name: HH breakout 12 — opening-range breakout with trend filter (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same opening-range/auction-imbalance edge — the first burst of directional flow after a session anchor sets the tone and latecomers/stops chase it — but on a 1h clock and gated by adx ABOVE a floor so the ORB break is only taken when a trend is actually present (filtering the dead-session ORB pokes that immediately revert, the defining ORB failure mode in chop). Uses the OpeningRangeBreakout module (setup.orb): range_bars and buffer are fitted ParamRefs. The 1h clock defines a wider opening-range window and rides the resolved move for hours rather than minutes — a distinct frequency/hold cell from the 15m ORB variant. Counterparty: Asia-session range-traders and passive LPs swept by the Western open. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the ORB break at the anchor beats a random-hour placebo by nothing (the anchor is arbitrary in 24/7 crypto), OR if the adx trend gate is decorative (removing it leaves the edge intact), OR if a placebo anchor at 00:00 UTC performs identically, OR if the edge is BTC/ETH-only per-symbol.
catalyst: opening-range break confirmed by an active trend
